effect_size: Cohen dz: mean paired difference / sample SD of paired differences
bootstrap: 10000 chapter-pair percentile bootstrap replicates, two-sided pointwise 95% intervals
multiplicity: Primary Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment over all 36 paired tests. Separate within-level BH18 and familywise Holm36 are sensitivity outputs. Chapter and segment-mean length-adjusted edition coefficients each use separate BH18; 36 chapter length correlations use separate BH36; historical block exploratory tests use BH72.

length_diagnostics.model: H_HM,c - H_YY,c = beta_edition + beta_loglength * (ln(N_HM,c) - ln(N_YY,c)) + error_c
length_diagnostics.note: Equivalent to a chapter fixed-effect model with a common log-token-count slope. HC3 standard errors; two-sided t inference with 118 df. The edition coefficient estimates the contrast at equal token counts. Observational adjustment cannot isolate causal edition or translator effects.

segment_mean_length_diagnostics.model: H_HM,c - H_YY,c = beta_edition + beta_loglength * (ln(N_HM,c) - ln(N_YY,c)) + error_c
segment_mean_length_diagnostics.note: Equivalent to a chapter fixed-effect model with a common log-token-count slope. HC3 standard errors; two-sided t inference with 118 df. The edition coefficient estimates the contrast at equal token counts. Observational adjustment cannot isolate causal edition or translator effects.

inference_scope: Chapter-level model-based comparisons conditional on these two editions of one literary work. Chapter independence is an approximation; inferential intervals do not establish generalization to other works or individual translator causality.
